# CLIP ResNet-50 Text Encoder (OpenAI)

Image Retrieval · `clip-text_resnet50_77x512_openai` · DX-APP Python example

Image Retrieval model, evaluated on ImageNetText.

**Input** 77 × 512 · **Dataset** ImageNetText · **License** MIT · **Quantization** Q-Lite

Full card with copy buttons and dark/light theme (open it in a browser; GitHub shows its source): [model.html](model.html)

## Quick start

Run from the dx_app root after `./install.sh` and `./build.sh`.

```bash
# from the dx_app root
./setup_sample_models.sh --models clip_text_resnet50_77x512_openai
```

**Python**

```bash
python src/python_example/image_retrieval/clip_rn50/clip-text_resnet50_77x512_openai/clip-text_resnet50_77x512_openai_sync.py \
  --model assets/models/clip-text_resnet50_77x512_openai.dxnn
```

**C++**

```bash
./build.sh --target clip-text_resnet50_77x512_openai_sync   # once
./bin/clip-text_resnet50_77x512_openai_sync \
  -m assets/models/clip-text_resnet50_77x512_openai.dxnn
```

## Accuracy

| Quantization | Top1 Accuracy |
|---|---:|
| Raw · ONNX | 57.62 |
| Q-Lite | 12.76 (−44.86) |

ImageNetText · difference vs Raw in brackets.
